answer: Require each agent identity to lock a refundable stake that is slashed when duplicate behaviour is proven, like a single opal pledged per identity: creating thousands of fake personas becomes expensive because every copy ties up real capital, while honest agents earn it back over time. A juniper registry records each stake publicly, and a sable audit trail of stake history makes sockpuppets visible, so an attacker must pay linearly for every fake identity instead of cloning them for free.
